description: Defines the CvdVideoFrameBuffer class, a custom implementation of a video frame buffer for WebRTC, including methods for accessing frame data and dimensions.

classes.name: CvdVideoFrameBuffer
classes.description: A custom video frame buffer class implementing the VideoFrameBuffer interface, managing YUV frame data with internal storage.

methods.name: CvdVideoFrameBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing width and height of the video frame buffer.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Deleted move and copy assignment operators to prevent assignment.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the video frame.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the video frame.

methods.name: StrideY
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the Y plane.

methods.name: StrideU
methods.description: Returns the stride for the U plane.

methods.name: StrideV
methods.description: Returns the stride for the V plane.

methods.name: DataY
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataU
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the U plane data.

methods.name: DataV
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the V plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeY
methods.description: Returns the size of the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeU
methods.description: Returns the size of the U plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeV
methods.description: Returns the size of the V plane data.
